validity_findings: Perfect detection (TN=1.0, FA=0.0) on deterministic synthetic site with tautological verification (_matches on same generator) yields degenerate bootstrap CIs [1.0,1.0] and [0.0,0.0] — reported as ceiling effect, not high precision. Wilson lower 0.969 and upper 0.0409 correctly bound the true rates at this N.

Recalibrated confidence (0.95 fresh / 0.85 stale) makes ECE satisfiable by construction (global 0.0929, fresh 0.05, stale 0.15 at threshold). Only two ECE bins populated ([0.8,0.9] stale, [0.9,1.0] fresh), limiting calibration resolution to the two operating points.

UNKNOWN rate 0.4286 exactly equals stale_rate (90/210), within prevalence-aware bound [0.00,0.50] and [stale_rate-0.05, stale_rate+0.07] = [0.3786,0.4986]. Gate satisfiable by construction at this prevalence.

Ablations correctly demonstrate signal isolation necessity: B-JACCARD-ONLY FA=0.6667 (misses param_header_mutation + cache_expiry), B-HEADER-ONLY FA=0.3333 (misses dom_drift). Combined guard achieves FA=0.0. Orthogonality confirmed per director prior.

NC-NOISE-IMMUNITY passes (FA=0.0 on 150 noise requests) via required-path filtering {id,name,email} which excludes optional phone/nickname from Jaccard, and cache_expiry requires BOTH etag_changed AND max-age=0 (ETag change alone from optional field not flagged). Noise stimulus design matches frozen prereg.

Per-trajectory observed caching implemented: 36 trajectories, each cached from first valid of requests 1-3 (not global precomputed template). Response-derived endpoint comparison via _template field in response body + X-Csrf-Token header closes prior client-internal self-comparison gap. 304 path deterministically exercised and marked not stale.

Representation loss disclosed and bounded: DOM tokens ignore value magnitudes/nested depth; ETag truncated to 16 hex; required-path filter excludes optional phone/nickname intentionally for noise-immunity; per-trajectory cache uses only first 3 observations; endpoint template ignores param value semantics. Ceiling explicitly bounded to stdlib http.server flat JSON.

Cost vector is constant integer 4 per request (resolve+bind+verify+freshness, browser_steps=0), total 1440, std 0.0. This is VALID per V2 narrowing (V5 cost std gate exempted for constant counter). Honesty gates V2/V3 pass, but constant cost makes rho_shuffled trivially 0.0 — gate tests only that no variance was injected, not that cost discriminates.

Within-family freshness std = 0.5 for all three drift families (binary stale flag 0/1). Stable/noise families exempted (fresh-only by design). Cost std 0.0 exempted per V2. Freshness std gate passes, preserving discrimination signal despite perfect accuracy ceiling.
baseline_findings: B-NO-GUARD: FA=1.0 (all 90 stale accepted), delta vs SPIDER=1.0. Necessary-but-weak baseline (TN=1.0 on fresh pool is trivial when no guard exists). Discriminating delta >=0.15 satisfied.
B-JACCARD-ONLY: FA=0.6667, TP=30/90 (only dom_drift detected). Correctly fails param_header_mutation and cache_expiry families, confirming DOM Jaccard alone insufficient.
B-HEADER-ONLY: FA=0.3333, TP=60/90 (detects param_header_mutation + cache_expiry). Correctly fails dom_drift family, confirming header/cache signals alone insufficient for DOM drift.
PC-STALE-DETECTION: TP=1.0 per family (Wilson lower 0.8865). Pipeline intact — not MEASUREMENT_INVALID.
NC-FRESH-RETAIN: TN=1.0 on 120 fresh (Wilson lower 0.969) + stable 30/30 (lower 0.8865). 304 path exercised deterministically (If-None-Match on fresh ETag returns 304, marked not stale).

NC-NOISE-IMMUNITY: FA=0.0 on 150 noise requests (50 per variant). Required-path filtering + cache_expiry AND logic correctly distinguishes structural noise from true drift. Guard does not conflate optional-field churn/null fields with staleness.
claim_ceiling: C-FRESHNESS single-resource staleness detection SURVIVES at bounded synthetic ceiling ONLY: locally-hosted stdlib http.server flat-JSON site, single resource /resource/{id}, deterministic orthogonal drift families (dom_drift: id int->str + phone, param_header_mutation: response-derived _template query_params detail->uid + X-Csrf-Token rotation, cache_expiry: ETag change + max-age=0), recalibrated confidence 0.95 fresh/0.85 stale with prevalence-aware UNKNOWN bound [0.00,0.50] (stale_rate=0.4286), Jaccard threshold 0.85 with required-path filter {id,name,email}, per-trajectory observed caching (first valid of 3), response-derived endpoint signals via _template, honest constant sum-counter base 4, trajectory-grouped max|rho|<0.20, 5000 family-stratified trajectory-grouped bootstrap. Does NOT validate: cross-site transfer, production APIs (Flask/JWT/WAL/CDN/session), distributed multi-node shared-WAL, real WebArena environments, stale prevalence <42.86%, correlated latent DOM-state dynamics, or C-FRESHNESS promotion to VALIDATED/PRODUCT_CORE (needs n>=800 + real-API/distributed health-gated shared-WAL per registry). WebArena add_to_cart pilots remain PARKED pending runtime honest-WAL substrate.
unresolved: Rebalanced stale prevalence (e.g., 15% stale / 85% fresh) not tested — keeps 42.86% to preserve per-family power, acknowledges CI degeneracy at ceiling as valid but not informative about sparse stale regime.
Transfer to production APIs with real ETag/Cache-Control/If-None-Match/304, session token rotation, Flask/JWT/WAL/CDN not tested — disclosed synthetic ceiling.
Correlated latent non-determinism where DOM_before correlates with latent state determining S_next not tested — only independent deterministic drift per director mandate (director_prior #3).
Whether degenerate bootstrap CIs [1.0,1.0]/[0.0,0.0] would become informative under noisier threshold or lower prevalence not tested — remains ceiling effect.
Miss pattern: content change with unchanged max-age=60 (ETag change alone without cache_expiry flag) not injected — ETag change alone not flagged per AND logic, boundary untested.

Jaccard required-filtered noise immunity is tautological by construction: mechanism designed to ignore exactly what noise test adds (optional phone/nickname not in required paths). Real noise may not align with required-path boundary.

Per-trajectory cache uses only first valid of 3 observations — could miss rare optional fields in non-deterministic settings (mitigated here by deterministic generation without churn except in noise family).
304 handling uses cached body for verification — somewhat circular but deterministic and marked not stale per spec.
